name: Human Behavior Frameworks & Theories
description: Theoretical behavioral models: BJ Fogg's B=MAP, Hook Model, CREATE Funnel, Dual Process Theory, Cue-Routine-Reward, Spectrum of Interventions, and Behavioral Ethics.

subskills.name: BJ Fogg's Behavior Model (B=MAP)
subskills.description: Behavior = Motivation x Ability x Prompt. Convergence above the action line.

subskills.name: Dual Process Theory (System 1 & System 2)
subskills.description: Kahneman's cognitive framework distinguishing fast automatic from slow deliberative thinking.

subskills.name: Behavioral Science Foundations & Heuristics
subskills.description: Anchoring, availability heuristic, framing effects, endowment effect, and cognitive fluency.

subskills.name: Nir Eyal's Hook Model
subskills.description: Four-phase habit loop: Trigger -> Action -> Variable Reward -> Investment.

subskills.name: CREATE Action Funnel (Stephen Wendel)
subskills.description: Six-stage behavioral funnel: Cue, Reaction, Evaluation, Ability, Timing, Experience.

subskills.name: Cue-Routine-Reward Habit Loop (Duhigg)
subskills.description: Charles Duhigg's habit loop: cue triggers a routine that delivers a craving-satisfying reward.

subskills.name: BJ Fogg's Behavior Grid (15 Behavior Types)
subskills.description: Classifying behaviors across 15 types (Green, Blue, Purple, Gray, Black x Dot, Span, Path).

subskills.name: Spectrum of Thinking Interventions
subskills.description: Graduating interventions from unconscious nudges to conscious deliberation tools.

subskills.name: Behavioral Ethics & Deceptive Design Defense
subskills.description: Auditing behavioral loops for ethical compliance, avoiding manipulative dark patterns and sludge.

github.signal: Design documentation analyzing B=MAP, Hook Model loops, or dark pattern defense audits

cv.signal: Applied Fogg B=MAP, Hook Model, and CREATE funnels to improve activation and retention metrics
Conducted behavioral ethics audits eliminating dark patterns and mapped Fogg Behavior Grid interventions

linkedin.signal: Endorsements in Behavioral Design, Cognitive Psychology, Hook Model, and Behavioral Economics

assessment.signal: Passes behavioral frameworks assessment covering B=MAP, CREATE funnel, Hook Model, Fogg Grid, and Dark Pattern audits

junior.description: Applies Fogg B=MAP motivation/ability/prompt concepts and accounts for System 1 heuristics.

mid.description: Designs variable reward loops in the Hook Model and diagnoses drop-offs with the CREATE action funnel.

senior.description: Selects strategic interventions across the 15-cell Fogg Grid, audits dark patterns, and enforces ethical user agency.
